title: BUGFIX — Achiri free tier qwen3:0.6b (fix 30s timeout)
rationale: Achiri bot @achiriibot went live (Sprint 1458) and received real user messages on 2026-03-26T09:00. All chat() calls timed out after 30s because qwen3:4b is too slow on the Mac Mini under load. Fix: change free tier model from local/qwen3:4b to local/qwen3:0.6b (2.3s response time vs 30s+). Also increase Ollama timeout from 30s to 60s as belt-and-suspenders. Both changes are config/1-line surgical edits.
